title: Answer: the classical world emerges by decoherence and the classical limit

statements.text: The classical world is emergent: decoherence turns the brain's state into a mixture of near-classical states, and classical physics is the limit in which Planck's constant goes to zero, a limit that hides the action of mind.

sources.quote: quantum decoherence was assumed to decompose the state of the brain into a mixture of essentially classical states
